answer: Ten fakes need five hands. Sixty inlets open each epoch, one lotus per channel; a claim locks 75 POA, +30 per extra identity from the same root, ten fakes lock 2,100 POA. Each inlet keeps a tide gauge: its reading is seeded by the last block plus the key, shown in one 15-minute window, needing a sable seal from two strangers elsewhere. One operator reads two gauges at most, so ten fakes need five hands, ten readings, twenty seals. A missed reading burns 20 POA; readings by one hand in a minute count as one. The chain verifies each reading against its channel; a farm buys bonds, not hands.
